subject: cs-9
description: Authentic 12-mark Section A Federal Board exam simulator covering Applications of Computer Science (AI, ML, Robotics, Cloud) by Lecturer Sabahat Ul Hasan.

questions.question: The process of taking an unknown or unlabeled data set as input to train the algorithm to discover hidden patterns is known as:
questions.explanation: Unsupervised machine learning algorithms analyze and cluster untagged, unclassified data to discover underlying patterns without pre-existing labels.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of AI used in everyday life?
questions.explanation: Autonomous self-driving vehicles utilize advanced AI computer vision and deep learning models to perceive surroundings and navigate roads.

questions.question: The technology concerned with performing specific tasks with little or no human intervention using computer-controlled machines is called:
questions.explanation: Robotics integrates engineering and computer science to build programmable, automated physical agents that carry out actions autonomously.

questions.question: A cloud computing model in which resources are owned and operated by a third-party cloud service provider is called:
questions.explanation: In a Public Cloud (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure), infrastructure is owned, hosted, and operated by external cloud providers and offered over the internet.

questions.question: Machine learning is a sub-field of AI that focuses on:

options.A: Manually programming each rule for a computer
options.B: Using past data and experience to make predictions and decisions

questions.explanation: Machine learning trains computational models on empirical datasets so systems improve performance and make accurate future predictions without explicit rule programming.

questions.question: Which term refers to using labelled data for training machine learning algorithms?
questions.explanation: Supervised Learning pairs input data with corresponding target labels so algorithms learn the mapping function between inputs and correct outputs.

questions.question: Speech recognition is a prominent application of:
questions.explanation: Speech recognition converts spoken voice audio into text, which is a foundational sub-discipline of Natural Language Processing (NLP).

questions.question: The AI technology that enables computer systems to obtain meaningful information from digital images and videos is called:
questions.explanation: Computer Vision empowers computers to interpret, process, and understand visual data from digital images and real-time camera video streams.

questions.question: Which of these is an example of AI applied in modern business?
questions.explanation: E-commerce platforms like Amazon use AI recommendation engines analyzing user browsing history to predict and recommend products.

questions.question: GitHub Copilot is an AI tool primarily used for:
questions.explanation: GitHub Copilot is an AI pair programmer powered by large language models that synthesizes code completions and suggestions within code editors.

questions.question: The main purpose of cloud computing is:

options.B: To provide on-demand services like storage, databases, and software via the internet
options.C: To store data only on a single user’s device
options.D: To make computers faster without internet

questions.explanation: Cloud computing delivers on-demand computing services—including servers, storage, databases, networking, and software—over the cloud with pay-as-you-go pricing.

questions.question: A chatbot is best defined as:

options.A: A program that combines AI with natural language to interact with users
options.D: A hardware device for storing chat history

questions.explanation: A chatbot is conversational software powered by NLP and AI designed to simulate human conversation via text or voice interactions.
